status: Bounded screen upload ownership migration; GPI-S2 remains in progress
selection: Default Renderer::upload_vertices rewrote each screen vertex stream every frame, kept separate capacity fields and retained historical peak allocations. Empty schematic streams skipped synchronization. Source inspection selected this production change; no numerical speedup claim.
competing_paths_retired: Skipping empty schematic streams while retaining stale allocation
change: ScreenBuffer owns the last exact content snapshot and GPU buffer. Equal content returns zero upload bytes regardless of source address. Adjacent dirty vertices are joined into writes; unchanged vertex gaps are skipped. Empty input releases both owners. Renderer replacement drops the owner. Painter order, passes, AA, shaders and uniform behavior are unchanged.

bounds.eviction: Overlarge content renders but bypasses snapshot retention. Empty input releases CPU/GPU storage; renderer/device teardown drops all owners.
bounds.gpu_capacity: At most four times last nonempty payload, with WGPU alignment. Larger-to-smaller transitions shrink allocations above that bound. This is an input-relative bound, not an absolute application GPU memory ceiling.
bounds.dirty_unit: One complete vertex (20 bytes in production), aligned to the four-byte queue-write requirement. Unchanged words inside a changed vertex are uploaded; unchanged vertices between dirty ranges are not.

proof.gpu_owner: Real GPU readback: cold 16 bytes; relocated identical content zero; same-address/equal-length single-u32 replacement 4 bytes; disjoint replacements 8 bytes and correct complete contents. Exact-cap warm hit, over-cap bypass, shrink, empty and reset pass.
proof.production_gpu: Actual dialog render path: warm zero menu upload, forced owner eviction requires upload with equal pixels; same-size vertex replacement uploads and restoration reproduces pixels.
proof.parity: Actual full-frame and dialog-only paths produce equal pixels at 1x/1.5x across scroll rows. Repeated full frames report zero panel/menu uploads and equal pixels.
proof.native: Fresh release X11 MAIN zoom-in/out and GLOBAL/PROJECT/NEW startup/presentation/close smoke pass; final exit zero. Native upload counters/latency not qualified.
proof.build_lint: Guarded offline release and renderer library/tests Clippy -D warnings pass. Initial test-only unnecessary-to-owned lint corrected by explicitly checking relocated source identity; failure retained.
proof.governance: Source health, dependency authority, parity, Cargo resource policy, traceability/spec/project, diff and staged rustfmt gates checked before commit.
proof.app_scope: No app source changes. Full app suite not rerun; prior known terminal restart-lineage failure and convergence drift remain open.

limits: Snapshot comparison and changed-content copies remain CPU work; overlarge streams bypass retention and upload normally. No numerical performance or zero-preparation claim.
Dirty ranges are vertex-granular, not byte-minimal. Complete REUSE-SCREEN native boundary counters and prescribed negative qualification remain open; this does not satisfy its full acceptance rule.
CPU screen geometry generation, world encoding/cache capacity qualification, complete text keys/payload/atlas bounds and S2 completion remain open.
Schematic stream migration is code adoption only; resolved schematic content performance remains unqualified without fixture admission.
No new dependency, vendoring, version/license, visual-prototype, product mutation or resize qualification change.
